title: Digi Matrix
author: gdeo607
description: A modulation matrix: any track's LFO can modulate any parameter of any track. SETTINGS > MOD MATRIX opens a page with 8 routing slots; each one picks a source (a track and one of its two LFOs), a destination (a track and one of its sound parameters), its own depth (-64..+64, independent of the source LFO's own DEP) and whether that LFO still modulates its own track as well. UP/DOWN choose a slot, YES turns it on and off, NO leaves, and the knobs edit the slot under the cursor: A source track, B source LFO, C destination track, D destination parameter, E depth, F own track on/off. The matrix is kept in the kit (two unused parameter slots of each track's sound), so every pattern has its own and it is saved with the project.
